reason: The new controllers/topic-unsubscribe.js.es6 (patch lines 26-31) only defines `stopNotificiationsText`, which calls I18n.t with `{title: model.fancyTitle}`. The `i18n` helper in helpers/i18n.js.es6:3-4 already passes hash params through to I18n.t, and templates already use it this way (e.g. templates/topic.hbs:94 `{{{i18n "queue.has_pending_posts" count=...}}}`), so `{{{i18n "topic.unsubscribe.stop_notifications" title=model.fancyTitle}}}` would do the same job.
